intro.title: DocumentAI
intro.subtitle: An open-source, configurable document processing service

segments.text: DocumentAI is an open-source document processing service. It checks if a document is processable, readable, complete and consistent, and extracts information from the document where possible.
Here, we upload a synthetic paystub. DocumentAI returns data in a consistent, structured format.
Extracted values link back to their location in the source document and each has an associated confidence score.
DocumentAI fits existing design systems and interfaces, like warning a customer an upload is blurry or pre-filling a caseworker portal for review.
Administrators can define required fields by document type. Here, Employee ID, gross pay and pay period are required.
Metrics show volume, outcomes and processing times. Paired with program outcomes, they give a holistic view of the system's impact on people and programs.
What would *your* agency need to configure, understand or measure before trying DocumentAI?
